items.quote: And all the wise men, that wrought all the work of the sanctuary, came every man from his work which they made;
items.claim: The skilled workers building the sanctuary each left their work to come and speak with Moses.
items.actor: the wise men that wrought all the work of the sanctuary

items.quote: And they spake unto Moses, saying, The people bring much more than enough for the service of the work, which the LORD commanded to make.
items.claim: The workers told Moses that the people were bringing much more than was needed for the work the LORD had commanded.
items.action: spake unto Moses, reporting a surplus of contributions
items.object: the people's offerings for the service of the work
items.mechanism: The people's voluntary offerings went beyond what the commanded work required.
